    An ecosystem where education, research, and entrepreneurship drive one another

    Read our vision

    Education

    Dreams into Questions

    Learning by building

    Through hands-on education in which students design, build, and test robots themselves, we develop robotics talent with both theoretical knowledge and practical implementation skills.

    Education programs

    Research

    Questions into Research, Research into Technology

    Research beyond disciplinary boundaries

    Researchers from engineering, AI, medicine, and other fields define problems together and develop the human-centered physical AI robotics technologies that society and industry actually need.

    National Research Lab

    Entrepreneurship

    Technology into Reality

    From research to the real world

    Our Lab-to-Market framework, which spans technology development, scale-up, and commercialization, helps research outcomes grow into new ventures.

    Entrepreneurship

    Return to RI  Researchers who launch ventures can return to the Robotics Institute (RI) to continue their research. What they learn in the field flows back into education and research, becoming the questions of the next generation.

    Work with the Institute

    For joint projects, industry collaboration, and visits, see Engage.
